description_en: Enables or disables the global agent switch for Application Monitoring, or queries the status of the global agent switch
description_zh: 打开或关闭应用监控的Agent总开关，或者查询Agent总开关的状态
name: ConfigApp

parameters.help_en: The IDs (PIDs) of the applications. Separate multiple PIDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 应用的ID标识串（PID）。多个PID以半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: app_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the global agent switch for one or more applications. Monitoring stops after the switch is disabled. If you do not specify this parameter, the current status of the global agent switch for the specified applications is queried. Valid values:
true: Enables the global agent switch.
false: Disables the global agent switch
parameters.help_zh:
打开或关闭一个或多个应用的Agent总开关。关闭开关后即停止监控。如果不填写该参数，则表示查询目标应用当前的Agent总开关状态。

`true`：打开Agent总开关
`false`：关闭Agent总开关
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en: The application type. Only TRACE is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用类型，目前仅支持设置为TRACE
parameters.name: type

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation is successful or the status of the global agent switch for the specified applications.
Operation result:
success: The operation is successful.
failed: The operation failed.
Status of the global agent switch:
true: The global agent switch is enabled.
false: The global agent switch is disabled
Data.description_zh:
操作是否成功或者目标应用的Agent总开关状态。
操作是否成功：

success
failed

Agent总开关状态：
true
false
